name: Dye-Advection LIC
definition: A 3D extension of LIC that introduces dye advection into the computation, using the 'smearing' nature of LIC to simulate dye advection.
summary: Dye-Advection LIC is a 3D flow visualization technique that injects colored dye into a vector field, allowing users to track specific material paths and wavefronts by propagating color only in the forward flow direction.
